columns_never_fillable.evidence: Pages 30-55 property cards and Portfolio Statement pages 113-115 disclose net lettable area/floor space but not GLA/GFA for property rows; NLA is populated where disclosed.
Singapore leasehold rows disclose 99-year start year and remaining term but no exact expiry date; left null rather than deriving.

Portfolio Statement page 113 lists Suntec Singapore committed occupancy as 'n/m' (not meaningful) for both 2024 and 2023, and the property card (pages 34-35) discloses no occupancy % for the convention/exhibition venue (event-based, not leased occupancy). Left null. All other consolidated property rows have occupancy from the property cards / Portfolio Statement page 113.

ORQ, MBFC, Southgate and Nova cards disclose Net Income Contribution (share of profits/JV loan interest), not property-level gross revenue or NPI attributable to the REIT. Note 7 gives JV revenue/expenses at JV-entity level, not property NPI rows.
FY2024 strata-unit divestments are disclosed as an aggregate across six units completed during FY2024 plus one unit completed 6 Jan 2025; no per-unit completion dates are disclosed.

data_with_no_home: Suntec City combined card page 30: NLA 2,130,699 sq ft (Office 1,213,469; Retail 917,200 incl. 66.3% Suntec Singapore/recreational facilities), purchase price S$2,312.7m, market valuation S$5,974.0m, gross revenue S$350.5m, NPI S$224.8m, occupancy 98.6%. Split property rows use Portfolio Statement/segment note where available.
JV net income contributions from property cards: ORQ S$30.2m; MBFC S$38.8m; Southgate S$2.5m; Nova S$28.6m. These are below-NPI share-of-profit style metrics and not recorded as property NPI.
Portfolio marketing AUM page 24 totals S$11,752.5m on Suntec REIT-interest basis; not the audited consolidated investment-properties total.
FX evidence: AUD valuation rate A$1.00=S$0.8478; AUD revenue/NPI rate A$1.00=S$0.8804; GBP valuation rate £1.00=S$1.7043; GBP revenue/NPI rate £1.00=S$1.7082.
parsing_traps: Three-tier valuation trap: market_valuation for directly held/consolidated properties uses audited Portfolio Statement pages 113/115 in S$000 multiplied by 1,000. Marketing AUM table page 24 is S$ millions and Suntec REIT-interest basis, not the primary audited carrying value source.

Held-for-sale trap: page 113 Suntec City Office active carrying value S$3,282.874m excludes one strata unit reclassified as investment property held for sale at S$13.126m. Page 115 full Suntec City Office valuation S$3,296.0m includes that HFS piece.

JV/equity-accounted treatment: ORQ, MBFC, Southgate and Nova are economic portfolio rows but not individual investment-property rows in the audited Portfolio Statement. They sit inside Interests in joint ventures (Note 7); property-card/AUM values are Suntec REIT-interest market valuations and rows are flagged equity_accounted_jv.
Suntec Singapore is 66.3%-owned but consolidated at 100% in the Group Portfolio Statement (S$746.7m); the marketing AUM value of S$495.0m is the 66.3% interest value.

segment_income_provenance.source: Note 28 OPERATING SEGMENTS, table 'Information about reportable segments'
segment_income_provenance.note: Per-property gross_revenue and net_property_income for all 8 consolidated segment-note rows are taken from Note 28 (page 163), in S$'000 x 1,000. Row-level source_page stays 113 (audited Portfolio Statement, primary source of market_valuation/tenure/occupancy); GR/NPI provenance is page 163.
segment_income_provenance.npi_inference_note: NPI was NOT computed as Revenue - Property expenses: Note 28 discloses a dedicated 'Reportable segment net property income' row (line 5739) alongside Revenue and Property expenses. Values recorded verbatim from that NPI row (e.g. The Minster Building Revenue 23,898 / expenses (2,853) / disclosed NPI 21,045 = ties out). No imputation.

Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition.note: Sum of Convention (Rev 63,711 / NPI 17,358) and Suntec Singapore Retail (Rev 22,423 / NPI 15,716); the retail space is the ~144,000 sq ft within the convention centre. Ties to page 30 combined-card Suntec Singapore GR S$86.1m.

segment_income_provenance.segment_note_total_check: Sum of the 9 disclosed segment columns: Revenue 463,556 / NPI 310,759 (line 5737/5739 'Total' column ties). Foreign columns already translated to S$'000 in Note 28, so GR/NPI currency = SGD for every row; FX rates retained in flags for audit trail.
segment_income_provenance.jv_rows_absent: One Raffles Quay, MBFC Properties, Southgate Complex and Nova Properties are equity-accounted JV rows and do NOT appear in the consolidated Note 28 segment table; per-property GR/NPI genuinely absent from the consolidated accounts and left null (see columns_never_fillable). Their property cards disclose only a below-NPI 'Net Income Contribution'.

jv_income_recovery.conclusion: No attributable NET PROPERTY INCOME is disclosed for any of the four equity-accounted JV rows (One Raffles Quay, MBFC Properties, Southgate Complex, Nova Properties). net_property_income and gross_revenue correctly left null for all four; each row carries an 'npi_not_disclosed' flag.

sources_checked.note_28_operating_segments_page_163: Segment table covers only the 8 consolidated segments; equity-accounted JVs are explicitly EXCLUDED (share of profit of JVs is an unallocated reconciling item, page 163-164). No JV segment NPI exists.
sources_checked.note_7_interests_in_joint_ventures_page_: Discloses summarised JV financial info at 100% JV level: Revenue and total Expenses only (Expenses is entity-level, per footnote [a] includes depreciation, interest income, interest expense and tax) — NOT property operating expenses, so no property-NPI line can be isolated — plus the Group's share of total return.
sources_checked.property_cards: Each JV card discloses only a below-NPI 'Net Income Contribution' = share of profits (excl. net fair-value change of investment properties) + interest income on the JV loan.

jv_income_recovery.why_not_forced: Note 7 gives only 100% Revenue and 100% total Expenses (which bundle interest/depreciation/tax), so a clean attributable property NPI cannot be derived without fabricating a split of a combined figure. 'Net Income Contribution' and 'share of total return' are share-of-profit metrics, not property NPI, so they are NOT mapped to net_property_income.

reconciliation.direct_consolidated_including_hfs_check: S$7,840.279m active direct properties + S$13.126m HFS = S$7,853.405m, matching page 115 property valuation table sum.
reconciliation.reconciliation_note: Property row sum includes audited direct active rows plus JV property-card/AUM Suntec-interest values, and therefore is intentionally not equal to audited Group investment properties. Direct active rows reconcile to S$7.840279b; adding HFS S$13.126m reconciles to the audited page 115 valuation table S$7.853405b.
